scripts.dev: npm run build -w @stellardrop/shared && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @stellardrop/api" "npm run dev -w @stellardrop/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @stellardrop/shared && npm run build -w @stellardrop/api && npm run build -w @stellardrop/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @stellardrop/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p netlify/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build -w @stellardrop/shared && npm run test -w @stellardrop/api
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w @stellardrop/shared && npm run test:integration -w @stellardrop/api
scripts.test:live: npm run build -w @stellardrop/shared && npm run test:live -w @stellardrop/api
